patch.summary: Is Salesforce Account Engagement worth it? Salesforce Account Engagement (Pardot) is Salesforce’s B2B marketing automation product for lead nurture, scoring, and Sales Cloud-aligned campaigns — typically packaged with Salesforce editions via custom quote. Marketing is secondary to CRM-primary catalogue…. Strong when Salesforce CRM customers needing B2B MA. Weak when MA product — pairs with Salesforce CRM rather than replacing it.

blocks.body: Salesforce Account Engagement earns a yes only when researched fit beats researched limits — not when the brand is familiar.

sections.heading: Salesforce Account Engagement: buy when the operating loop matches
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Commit when your weekly work needs contact management and Salesforce CRM customers needing B2B MA holds. Counter-signal: Walk when MA product — pairs with Salesforce CRM rather than replacing it would block go-live.

Capability hinge for this product: contact management; lead management; pipeline management; deal management.

Integrations in research: confirm on the product hub.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Enterprise.

sections.heading: Who Salesforce Account Engagement is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Account Engagement when Salesforce CRM + B2B MA alignment is required..

Avoid if: Compare HubSpot, Marketo, or ActiveCampaign if you are not standardized on Salesforce..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with HubSpot on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Salesforce Account Engagement price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Published packaging clarity vs ecosystem depth.

Next step: run contact management end-to-end, then decide.
